messages:
Maya (Design): quick thought — the run history card feels noisy when tool calls include long JSON payloads. Can we collapse the function args by default and show a one-line summary?
Ernest (DevEx): makes sense. Maybe show first 120 chars and a "view full" inline expander. avoids horizontal scroll.
Samir (PM): agree. Also we should keep the schema name visible so users know which function signature ran.
Ellie (A11y): accessibility nit: the expander needs an aria-expanded state and a clear keyboard target. Right now the whole payload area isn't focusable.
Maya (Design): good catch. Proposal: small chevron button with aria-label "Expand tool payload" and a visually-hidden text that reads "Press Enter to expand payload".
Ernest (DevEx): implementation question — if we collapse by default, how do we handle structured output previews? For schema-based tool responses we could render a compact key/value preview instead of raw JSON. e.g. name: value, status: ok.
Samir (PM): that'd help onboarding for non-devs. Also want a copy button on the collapsed preview so you can copy the small summary quickly.
Maya (Design): updated mock: compact preview shows up to 3 top-level keys (configurable). Overflow becomes "+2 more". The chevron expands to full JSON and highlights matching schema fields.
Ernest (DevEx): prototype notes: we can reuse existing <CodeBlock> with prop `collapsed` and a toggle. For schema matching highlighting we'll need to pass the function's JSON schema to the renderer. Small snippet: 
```
<CodeBlock collapsed initialLines={3} schema={fnSchema} />
```
Ellie (A11y): test cases: keyboard-only expand/collapse, screen reader announces "Tool payload collapsed, 3 keys visible" and after expand announce "Tool payload expanded, 42 lines". Also ensure the copy button has aria-live polite to confirm copy.
Samir (PM): one more UX callout — when a tool call errors, show the error inline with a subtle red badge and an action link "open trace" so folks can jump to the full invocation.
Maya (Design): agree, and add microcopy: "Tool call failed — check input schema and model logs". Keep copy concise.
Ernest (DevEx): technical caveat: collapsing big KV caches should avoid O(n) stringify on render. We should cache summary strings on the invocation record.
Maya (Design): good — we can add an annotation icon for "cached summary" with tooltip "summary generated at invocation time".
deploy-bot: deploy queued for branch playground-compact-preview (build 4821) :rocket:
Ernest (DevEx): Implementation plan: I can spike the collapsed CodeBlock + schema-aware preview tomorrow. Will PR the UI change behind a feature flag.
Maya (Design): thanks. For copy text: prefer "Expand payload" / "Collapse payload" and use "Show full output" for the run-history action to differentiate.
Ellie (A11y): final checklist for PR: focus order, aria-expanded, aria-controls, live region for copy, and contrast for the +N overflow badge.
Samir (PM): timeline: spike -> design review -> small beta to 10% of dev sandbox by end of sprint?
Maya (Design): sounds good. tagging @Ernest and @Ellie for follow-up. :thumbsup:
